item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 13/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring fine and dry weather to Guangdong tomorrow. With the monsoon moderating midweek this week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of this week. The weather will become cool over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Rai will intensify gradually in the next few days, and will move in the general direction of the southern part of the Philippines, across the southern part of the South China Sea. Its associated cloud band will bring rainy weather to the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week.
